header.title: Note Type Creation Guide & AI Prompts
header.description: All technical details and standard prompts to help you craft perfect Flashcard templates without coding.

prompt_tab.master_desc: Copy the prompt frame below, append your requirements, and send it to ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini.
prompt_tab.quick_tip_text: After AI responds, you will get: (1) Fields list to enter on Fields page, and (2) Front/Back/CSS code to paste on Template page.
prompt_tab.ex1_title: Vocabulary card with Kanji, Furigana, Sino-Vietnamese & Audio sentences
prompt_tab.ex2_title: Grammar card with Structure, Literary citations & Nuance comparisons
prompt_tab.copied_toast_desc: Open ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini and paste this prompt.

tech_tab.card1_desc: Flama uses standard Mustache templating. Vocabulary data is auto-populated into {{placeholder}} tags.
tech_tab.card2_desc: Supports safe mp3 pronunciation playback via speaker button 🔊 or auto-reading scripts.
tech_tab.card3_desc: Each card renders in an isolated environment, ensuring responsive layouts on both mobile and desktop.
tech_tab.ft_text_desc: Vocabulary, Kanji, short definitions, Romaji, author names...
tech_tab.ft_richtext_desc: Text with bold, italics, color highlights, underline, bullet lists.
tech_tab.ft_audio_desc: Pronunciation audio, example sentences, audio clips (mp3, wav, m4a).
tech_tab.ft_markdown_desc: Long articles, comparison tables, complex grammar formulas.
tech_tab.ft_diagram_desc: Sentence syntax tree, visual semantics diagram.

steps_tab.step1_desc: Go to NoteTypes Manager, enter a name (e.g. N3 Vocab), and click Create NoteType.
steps_tab.step2_desc: Click Manage Fields, add fields according to AI's table (matching field names and types).
steps_tab.step3_desc: Navigate to Template Details, paste Front HTML, Back HTML, and Shared CSS, then click Save Template.
steps_tab.step4_desc: Right panel will display live card mockup. Flip Front / Back and test speaker 🔊 button.

rules_tab.rule2_desc: Use lowercase alphanumeric characters separated by underscores (e.g. word, audio_word, example_en) for maximum compatibility.
rules_tab.rule3_desc: On Front side, use centering Flexbox: style="min-height: 200px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;" for smooth responsiveness across devices.

errors.shared_schema_versioning: This template is part of a shared deck and cannot be added, deleted, or reset. You can still modify HTML/CSS content.
errors.requires_at_least_one: Note type requires at least one template.
errors.generic: An error occurred. Please try again.

tour.subtitle: For beginners
tour.step1_desc: A Note Type defines data structures (such as vocabulary, readings, audio files, images...) and determines how Flashcards look.
tour.step2_title: ✨ 2. No coding skills? Use AI Prompts!
tour.step2_desc: Flama provides standardized Master Prompts. Simply copy the prompt, fill in your requirements, and send it to ChatGPT / Claude for automated HTML/CSS generation.
tour.step2_btn: Open AI Prompt page in new tab
tour.step3_desc: Enter the note type name (e.g., JLPT N3 Vocabulary, N2 Grammar) into the "Create New Note Type" input below, then click Create NoteType.
tour.step4_desc: After creation, the system takes you to Manage Fields to add data columns. Next, visit Template Details to paste Front/Back/CSS code and check Live Preview.

manager_tour.step1_desc: Enter the name of the note type you want to create (e.g., N3 Vocabulary, N2 Grammar, Kanji) in this field.
manager_tour.step2_desc: Click this button to initialize the note type. You will automatically be redirected to the Fields management page to add data columns.
manager_tour.step3_desc: No programming needed! Click here to open the guide and copy the Master Prompt for ChatGPT / Claude to design card templates for you.
manager_tour.step4_cards_desc: Each card displays the note type name along with two key badges: number of Templates (display card faces) and number of Fields.
manager_tour.step5_fields_desc: Click here to add fields like Word, Meaning, Audio, Example, Furigana... defining data storage structure.
manager_tour.step6_templates_desc: Click here to open the Front & Back HTML/CSS editor, paste AI-generated code, and view real-time Live Preview.
manager_tour.step7_share_desc: Once designed, click this button to publish your card template to the Marketplace for the Flama community.
manager_tour.step4_empty_desc: After creating note types, they will appear here with action buttons: Manage Fields, Customize Templates, Live Preview, and Share to Marketplace.

guide_tour.step1_desc: This comprehensive documentation helps you create any Flashcard template for Flama without writing code.
guide_tour.step2_desc: Quickly switch between 4 categories: Sample AI Prompts, Card Technology, 4-Step Process, and Golden Rules to Avoid Errors.
guide_tour.step3_desc: Click "Copy Full Prompt" to copy the standard instructions and send to ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini to generate HTML/CSS.
guide_tour.step4_desc: Browse and quickly copy sample prompts for Vocabulary cards or JLPT Grammar cards.
guide_tour.step5_desc: After getting code from AI, click this button to return to Note Types Management and apply your designs.

ai_modal.dialog_title: Guide & AI Prompts for NoteType Templates
ai_modal.dialog_desc: Use AI (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) to generate standard Flama Flashcard templates in 1 minute.
ai_modal.simple_usage_desc: Copy the Master Prompt below, customize [MY REQUIREMENTS] to your liking, and send it to AI. It will generate field definitions, Front HTML, Back HTML, and CSS.
ai_modal.toast_desc: Open ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini and paste this prompt.
